description:
You describe. AI delivers. Documents, slides, analysis, research, and beyond — done locally, fully private.

One Workspace, Every Task

Smart Document Generation
Generate professional documents, reports, and articles with one click. Support multiple export formats for effortless writing.

Presentation Creation
AI-powered PPT generator that automatically creates beautiful slides with customizable themes and animations.

Data Analysis Sheets
Intelligently process and analyze data, automatically generate charts and visual reports for clear insights.

Deep Research
Powerful web search and information integration capabilities to help you quickly access and analyze massive amounts of data.

Multimodal Creation
Support creation and conversion of multiple content forms including text, images, and audio. Unleash unlimited creativity.

Privacy & Security
Run locally with guaranteed data security. Your files and conversations always stay on your local device.
